edges.reason: block.timestamp (now) is fed into the keccak256 randomness seed, making the result miner-influenceable.
msg.sender is part of the randomness seed, so the caller can bias the pseudo-random outcome.
gigaapple is mixed into the randomness seed as an incrementing counter.
randomItIs performs the timestamp-based modulo computation that yields the returned screen.
The randomness operation increments gigaapple after computing the seed.
randomItIs consumes msg.sender when building its entropy input.
Local screen stores the modulo result returned by randomItIs.

greenapple caps the transferred amount for non-whitelisted senders.
